wiki_article:
**EA-ARK-ASCII-01: The Space Ark — ASCII Spatial Transform** is a score and executable transform by Lee Sharks dated 10 March 2026, held in this record as a **metadata capture**.

The Ark's transform family renders the same object in different substrates — glyphic, emoji, ASCII, shadow — on the principle that a transmissible object should survive passage through channels of differing capacity. The **ASCII spatial transform** is the most constrained of these: the Ark rendered in characters that survive any encoding, any terminal, any degraded channel.

That constraint is the point rather than a limitation. An archive whose central object exists only in rich media is one that cannot be transmitted where rich media fails, and the ASCII transform is the version that arrives when everything else is stripped. The record was assembled from a DataCite full-metadata capture after the 19 June 2026 termination, with no live authorial surface available at restoration time.
